comment.text: NOTCH2 R5 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Adrenocortical carcinoma; Clear cell renal cell carcinoma; Ovarian carcinoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.
